# Patent Summary: US12168819B2

**Title:** Modified La-Fe-Si magnetocaloric alloys
**Applicants:** UNIV IOWA STATE RES FOUND INC [US], Iowa State University Research Foundation, Inc.
**Inventors:** PATHAK ARJUN K [US], MUDRYK YAROSLAV [US], DOLOTKO OLEKSANDR [DE], PECHARSKY VITALIJ K [US], Pathak, Arjun K., Mudryk, Yaroslav, Dolotko, Oleksandr, Pecharsky, Vitalij K.
**Filing Date:** 20220216

## Abstract
[0001]    A magnetocaloric material comprising a La—Fe—Si based alloy composition that is compositionally modified to include a small but effective amount of at least one of Al, Ga, and In to improve mechanical stability of the alloy (substantially reduce alloy brittleness), improve thermal conductivity, and preserve comparable or provide improved magnetocaloric effects. The alloy composition may be further modified by inclusion of at least one of Co, Mn, Cr, and V as well as interstitial hydrogen.

# Patent Summary: US10096411B2 **Title:** BONDED La(Fe,Si)13-BASED MAGNETOCALORIC MATERIAL AND PREPARATION AND USE THEREOF **Applicants:** HU FENGXIA [CN], CHEN LING [CN], BAO LIFU [CN], WANG JING [CN], SHEN BAOGEN [CN], SUN JIRONG [CN], GONG HUAYANG [CN], CHINESE ACAD PHYSICS INST [CN], HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MATERIALS MFG CO LTD [CN], INST PHYSICS CAS [CN], HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MAT MANUFACTURING CO LTD [CN], HU FENGXIA, CHEN LING, BAO LIFU, WANG JING, SHEN BAOGEN, SUN JIRONG, GONG HUAYANG, INSTITUTE OF PHYSICS, CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES, HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MATERIALS MANUFACTURING CO., LTD., Hu Fengxia, Chen Ling, Bao Lifu, Wang Jing, Shen Baogen, Sun Jirong, Gong Huayang **Inventors:** HU FENGXIA [CN], CHEN LING [CN], BAO LIFU [CN], WANG JING [CN], SHEN BAOGEN [CN], SUN JIRONG [CN], GONG HUAYANG [CN], HU FENGXIA, CHEN LING, BAO LIFU, WANG JING, SHEN BAOGEN, SUN JIRONG, GONG HUAYANG, Hu, Fengxia, Chen, Ling, Bao, Lifu, Wang, Jing, Shen, Baogen, Sun, Jirong, Gong, Huayang **Filing Date:** 20120517 **Publication Date:** 20181009 **Priority Date(s):** N/A **IPC:** F25B 21/00, H01F 1/01, B22F 1/00, B22F 3/02 **CPC:** F25B 21/00, H01F 1/015, F25B 2321/002 ## Abstract [0001] Provided is a high-strength, bonded La(Fe, Si)<13>-based magnetocaloric material, as well as a preparation method and use thereof. The magnetocaloric material comprises magnetocaloric alloy particles and an adhesive agent, wherein the particle size of the magnetocaloric alloy particles is less than or equal to 800 μm and are bonded into a massive material by the adhesive agent; the magnetocaloric alloy particle has a NaZn<13>-type structure and is represented by a chemical formula of La<1-x>R(Fe<1-p-q>Co

Mn)<13-y>SiA<α>, wherein R is one or more selected from elements cerium (Ce), praseodymium (Pr) and neodymium (Nd), A is one or more selected from elements C, H and B, x is in the range of 0≦x≦0.5, y is in the range of 0.8≦y≦2, p is in the range of 0≦p≦0.2, q is in the range of 0≦q≦0.2, α is in the range of 0≦α≦3.0. Using a bonding and thermosetting method, and by means of adjusting the forming pressure, thermosetting temperature, and thermosetting atmosphere, etc., a high-strength, bonded La(Fe, Si)<13>-based magnetocaloric material can be obtained, which overcomes the frangibility, the intrinsic property, of the magnetocaloric material. At the same time, the magnetic entropy change remains substantially the same, as compared with that before the bonding. The magnetic hysteresis loss declines as the forming pressure increases. And the effective refrigerating capacity, after the maximum loss being deducted, remains unchanged or increases. ## Legal Status - 2022-12-07 — FP (US): LAPSED DUE TO FAILURE TO PAY MAINTENANCE FEE - 2022-11-25 — STCH (US): INFORMATION ON STATUS: PATENT DISCONTINUATION - 2022-11-17 — LAPS (US): LAPSE FOR FAILURE TO PAY MAINTENANCE FEES - 2022-06-02 — FEPP (US): FEE PAYMENT PROCEDURE - 2019-05-16 — STCF (US): INFORMATION ON STATUS: PATENT GRANT - 2015-03-11 — AS (US): ASSIGNMENT - 2015-03-11 — AS (US): ASSIGNMENT ## Patent Family 5 family member(s) on record. # Patent Summary: US9657971B2 **Title:** First-order phase-transition La(Fe,Si)13-based magnetocaloric material showing small hysteresis loss and preparation and use thereof **Applicants:** CHINESE ACAD PHYSICS INST [CH], HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MATERIALS MFG C LTD [CN], INST PHYSICS CAS [CN], HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MAT MFG CO LTD [CN], INSTITUTE OF PHYSICS, CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES, HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MATERIALS MANUFACTURING C., LTD., Institute of Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hubei Quanyang Magnetic Materials Manufacturing Co., Ltd, HUBEI QUANYANG MAGNETIC MATERIALS MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. **Inventors:** HU FENGXIA [CN], CHEN LING [CN], WANG JING [CN], BAO LIFU [CN], WU RONGRONG [CN], SHEN BAOGEN [CN], SUN JIRONG [CN], GONG HUAYANG [CN], HU FENGXIA, CHEN LING, WANG JING, BAO LIFU, WU RONGRONG, SHEN BAOGEN, SUN JIRONG, GONG HUAYANG, Hu Fengxia, Chen Ling, Wang Jing, Bao Lifu, Wu Rongrong, Shen Baogen, Sun Jirong, Gong Huayang **Filing Date:** 20121024 **Publication Date:** 20170523 **Priority Date(s):** N/A **IPC:** C09K 5/14, F25B 21/00, C22C 28/00, C22C 38/00, C22C 38/02, C22C 38/04, C22C 38/10, C22C 38/30, F25B 25/00, H01F 1/01 **CPC:** C09K 5/14, C22C 28/00, C22C 38/005, C22C 38/02, C22C 38/04, C22C 38/10, C22C 38/30, F25B 21/00, H01F 1/015, B22F 2999/00, B22F 9/04, C22C 2202/02, F25B 2321/002, Y10T 428/2982 ## Abstract [0001] The invention provides a first-order phase-transition La(Fe,Si)<13>-based magnetocaloric material showing small hysteresis loss, and preparation and use thereof. The material has a NaZn<13>-type structure, is composed of granules with a particle size in the range of 15˜200 μm and not less than 15 μm, and is represented by chemical formula La<1-x>R(Fe<1-p-q>Co

Mn)<13-y>SiA<α>. The method for preparing the material comprises steps of preparing the material La<1-x>R(Fe<1-p-q>Co

Mn)<13-y>SiA<α> by smelting and annealing; and then crushing the material into powder with a particle size in the range of 15˜200 μm. Without changing the components, a La(Fe,Si)<13>-based magnetocaloric material showing small hysteresis loss and strong magnetocaloric effect can be obtained by adjusting the particle size within the range of 15˜200 μm. Utilization of this type of materials in the practical magnetic refrigeration application is of great significance. When the particle size is 10 μm or less, the stability of the magnetocaloric material is lost; the magnitude of magnetic entropy change is reduced dramatically; and thus it is no longer suitable for the practical application in magnetic refrigeration technology. # Patent Summary: US12584663B2

**Title:** Device and Method for Magnetic Refrigeration
**Applicants:** MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC RES LABORATORIES INC [US], MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP [JP], Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories, Inc., Mitsubishi Electric Corporation
**Inventors:** LIN CHUNGWEI [US], WANG BINGNAN [US], VETTERLING WILLIAM [US], TONOOKA SHUN [JP], OGASAHARA ATSUSHI [US], VETTERLING WILLIAM [JP], OGASAHARA ATSUSHI, Lin, Chungwei, Wang, Bingnan, Vetterling, William, Tonooka, Shun, Ogasahara, Atsushi
**Filing Date:** 20221220
**Publication Date:** 20260324
**Priority Date(s):** N/A
**IPC:** F25B 21/02
**CPC:** F25B 21/00, F25B 21/02, F25B 2321/002, Y02B 30/00

## Abstract
[0000]    A system for magnetic refrigeration is provided. The system includes a layered structure formed by a sequence of a plurality of magnetocaloric material (MCM) components interlinked with a sequence of a plurality of Peltier modules. Each Peltier module of the plurality of Peltier modules is sandwiched between two MCM components of the plurality of MCM components. The system further includes a power source configured to concurrently power each Peltier module in the sequence of the plurality of Peltier modules. Current in each powered Peltier module flows in a constant direction. The system further includes a magnetic source configured to apply spatially uniform magnetic field to the sequence of the plurality of MCM components.
